_note: Twenty synthetic historical road incidents (long-term memory seed). Not real events.

incidents.description: Stalled big rig blocking the right lane of I-680 southbound in dense morning fog. Two fleet vehicles confirmed the stopped truck within a minute using camera and lidar.
incidents.lesson: Stopped-truck reports in fog with two independent camera confirmations were accurate.

incidents.description: Aluminium ladder lying across the middle lane. Camera and lidar detections from three vehicles agreed on the location.
incidents.lesson: Debris confirmed by camera and lidar from several vehicles was real.

incidents.description: Standing water across both lanes under the railroad underpass after heavy rain at night. Two cars stalled and the road was closed for three hours.
incidents.lesson: Low-lying underpasses flood quickly in heavy rain; rerouting was the safe action.

incidents.description: Multi-vehicle collision blocking two southbound lanes near the I-580 interchange. Emergency vehicles on scene for 45 minutes.
incidents.lesson: Accidents near interchanges caused long queues; early alerts reduced hard braking.

incidents.description: Single radar-only detection of possible debris in the right lane with no camera confirmation. Passing vehicles reported the lane clear; likely a radar reflection from an overhead sign.
incidents.lesson: Radar-only debris reports without camera confirmation were often false.

incidents.description: Deep pothole in the southbound right lane of Tassajara Rd after rain. Two vehicles recorded a hard suspension jolt at the same location.
incidents.lesson: Repeated suspension jolts at one spot reliably indicated a pothole.

incidents.description: Disabled sedan partially blocking the shoulder and right lane westbound. Confirmed by a second vehicle and cleared by a tow truck after 30 minutes.
incidents.lesson: Shoulder breakdowns were usually cleared within 30 minutes.

incidents.description: Water pooled across the lanes at the low underpass near the creek during a winter storm at night. Depth was estimated above 20 cm and vehicles were rerouted.
incidents.lesson: Underpass flooding reports during storms were confirmed by later vehicles.

incidents.description: Stopped delivery truck with hazard lights in the left lane during fog. Visibility was about 120 m and approaching vehicles could not see it until very close.
incidents.lesson: In fog, approaching vehicles benefited from alerts issued before the truck was visible.

incidents.description: Two-car collision at the Dublin Blvd and Hacienda Dr intersection. One eastbound lane blocked for 25 minutes.
incidents.lesson: Intersection collisions blocked a single lane for under 30 minutes.

incidents.description: Radar-only object detection in the left lane at dusk with no camera or lidar confirmation. The next two vehicles reported no debris.
incidents.lesson: Single-sensor debris detections should wait for confirmation before alerting.

incidents.description: Pothole near the bus stop on Dublin Blvd westbound, confirmed by two vehicles and repaired within a week.
incidents.lesson: Potholes were low severity but persisted for days.

incidents.description: Rear-end collision in dense fog on I-580 eastbound. Low visibility made the stopped cars hard to see; three fleet vehicles confirmed the crash.
incidents.lesson: Fog plus stopped traffic was the highest-risk combination on this segment.

incidents.description: Flooded low point under the overpass during heavy rain at night. Water across the right lanes caused lane closures for two hours.
incidents.lesson: Low points under overpasses flooded during heavy night rain.

incidents.description: Tire tread in the southbound lane of Dougherty Rd. Camera images from two vehicles showed the same object.
incidents.lesson: Camera-confirmed debris was reliable.

incidents.description: Broken-down pickup truck in the northbound lane near the business park. Confirmed by a second vehicle and towed after 40 minutes.
incidents.lesson: Stopped vehicles on arterials were confirmed quickly by following traffic.

incidents.description: Single-sensor radar report of possible debris near the on-ramp with no camera confirmation. Passing vehicles cleared it; the detection was caused by a metal road plate.
incidents.lesson: Radar-only debris near metal road plates produced false alarms.

incidents.description: Stalled car in the eastbound right lane during light rain, confirmed by a second vehicle and cleared after 20 minutes.
incidents.lesson: Stalled cars in rain were cleared quickly.

incidents.description: Single-vehicle spinout against the median in rain on I-680 southbound. Debris and an emergency crew occupied the left lane for 35 minutes.
incidents.lesson: Wet-road accidents often left debris in the lane after the crash.

incidents.description: Minor collision in fog on Dublin Blvd westbound. Visibility around 150 m; two vehicles confirmed the crash scene.
incidents.lesson: Fog accidents on arterials were confirmed by the second vehicle within minutes.
